turns.customer: I want number 1. Find My is still on, but just send me the link.
turns.reply:
I can't send the link while Find My is still on. A phone with Find My on is locked to its owner, and checkout won't go through. It only takes a minute to turn off.

**If the phone turns on:** Settings, tap your name, Find My, Find My iPhone, turn it off.

**If it won't turn on:** on any phone or computer, go to icloud.com/find, sign in, choose the old phone under All Devices, then tap Remove This Device.

Type your Apple ID password only on your own device, never to me.

Once it's off, tell me and I'll send the link for the iPhone 13 128GB, grade B, with the top-up you saw.
